integrity: The formula is proved analytically with the implicit optimality equation, coordinate monotonicity, a residual-weight bound for p>2, integration of derivatives and explicit limiting perturbations. Literature evidence distinguishes general existence estimates from exact sharp constants.
scientific_limitations: Only real finite-dimensional \(\ell_p^n\), \(1<p<\infty\), and metric projection onto the fixed all-ones line are covered. Sharpness in the non-Hilbert cases is a local perturbation limit, not finite-pair attainment. Results do not extend to arbitrary subspaces or non-atomic Lp.
title: Exact Lipschitz phase diagram of metric projection onto the constant-vector line in real \(\ell_p^n\)
